about.text: Erinoid was the British name for Galalith casein-formaldehyde plastic: Syrolit Ltd took the UK licence and renamed itself Erinoid Ltd, making it at Dudbridge near Stroud, Gloucestershire.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

facts.v: Syrolit Ltd, renamed Erinoid Ltd, in the former Lightpill wool mill, Dudbridge, Stroud, Gloucestershire
UK manufacturing licence for galalith, taken 1914
